PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
